name: FSLogix
short_description: Microsoft profile technology that stores Windows user profiles in containers (virtual disks) and attaches them at sign-in, giving users a consistent profile across session hosts in virtual desktop environments.

evidence.quote: Lean on fslogix to roam the user's profile between machines
That's what Fslogix does. It stores the profile in a container, a virtual disk
The user profile challenge, why FS Logics matters?
